name: Minimal
summary: Big stacked caps in a warm cream serif over your torso, small one-word captions low on the left, a hand-drawn word now and then. Nothing bounces. No sound effects unless you switch them on.
notes: Titles show in CAPS, one short line per slash: "LEAVE IT / FOR 24 / HOURS". They sit over the torso. Type them in caps too, so each line is sized for its capitals.
The hook is a title with a "sub" line: it moves to the top by itself, and the sub becomes the small spaced-out handwritten line under it.
Captions sit low on the left (y 1180), clear of most hair. If yours still reaches them, set captions y in theme_overrides.
Mark 1 word now and then with "accent": true: it turns into the hand-drawn emphasis word.

Screenshots and charts: popup with "frame": true gets a white rounded border. The red X sticker is themes/minimal/red-x.svg (use its full path as the sticker's src); put it beside the title, clear of the face, e.g. x 820, y 1500.
End line: a cta with a short line and an emoji, in white.
Starts with no sound effects ("sfx_default": "none"). The Sound switch on the Edit page or Touch-ups turns them on, for this reel or every reel.
css: .cap { left: 40px; right: auto; max-width: 380px; text-align: left; text-transform: lowercase; font-weight: 600 !important; text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.55); }

.title .tsub { font-family: @accent !important; font-size: 40px !important; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .3em !important; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF !important; padding-top: 22px !important; line-height: 1.2; text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.55); }
.cta { background: transparent !important; box-shadow: none !important; color: #FFFFFF !important; text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }
.cta span { background: rgba(17,17,17,.6) !important; color: #F5EDB8 !important; padding: 0 .2em; border-radius: .16em; text-shadow: none; }
